description: This PHP class, AM_ProjectTemplatesTable, is responsible for rendering an HTML table for project tasks within the context of SuiteCRM. It retrieves linked resources, constructs task rows with various attributes, and generates the output for project templates.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesTable
classes.description: A class that renders an HTML table with project task data, retrieving related resources and handling display logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with project template ID and tasks, then calls draw to render the table.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Generates an HTML table to display project tasks, retrieving linked resources and outputting rows with task details.
